name: fms_generate_otp
description: Sends OTP for FMS custom hiring authentication. Does NOT verify OTP. Fails if Aadhaar invalid.

name: fms_verify_otp
description: Verifies OTP and returns session_token. Does NOT create bookings. Fails if OTP expired or incorrect.

name: fms_get_service_list
description: Returns list of available farm services (ploughing, harvesting, sowing, spraying, tilling) in a region with pricing. PUBLIC tool — no authentication. Does NOT book services. Fails if location invalid or no services found.

name: fms_search_providers
description: Searches for service providers by service type and location. Returns provider details, ratings, and availability. PUBLIC tool. Does NOT book. Fails if no providers match or location invalid.

name: fms_check_service_availability
description: Checks if a service is available for a specific date and location. Returns provider_status ('available', 'assigned', 'busy', 'unavailable'). PUBLIC tool. Does NOT book. Service may become unavailable due to weather or high demand. Fails if service_id or date invalid.

name: fms_create_booking
description: Books a farm service (service + machine + operator). Transitions booking_status to 'requested'. Service must be available. Requires session_token. Does NOT assign provider. Pricing depends on land area and service type. Fails if service unavailable, invalid date, or duplicate booking.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for booking tools.

name: fms_assign_provider
description: Assigns an available service provider to a confirmed booking. Transitions booking_status to 'assigned'. Booking must be 'confirmed'. Requires session_token. Does NOT execute service. Fails if no providers available, booking not confirmed, or provider already assigned.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for booking tools.

provider_id.description: Provider ID. Optional — auto-assigns if omitted.

name: fms_track_service
description: Tracks service execution status ('not_started', 'scheduled', 'in_progress', 'completed'). Requires session_token. Does NOT modify service. Fails if booking_id invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for booking tools.

name: fms_verify_completion
description: Verifies that service has been completed satisfactorily. Transitions booking_status to 'verified'. Service must be 'completed'. Farmer must confirm quality. Requires session_token. Does NOT process payment. Fails if service not completed or quality issues reported.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for booking tools.

name: fms_track_payment
description: Tracks payment_status ('not_initiated', 'pending', 'completed', 'failed'). Payment may be advance or post-service. Requires session_token. Does NOT process payments. Fails if booking_id invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for booking tools.

name: fms_get_booking_history
description: Retrieves all past service bookings. Requires session_token. Does NOT create bookings. Fails if no history.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for booking tools.

name: fms_reschedule_service
description: Reschedules a service booking to a new date. Only when 'requested' or 'confirmed'. Requires session_token. Fails if booking already assigned/active or scheduling conflict.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for booking tools.

name: fms_cancel_booking
description: Cancels a service booking. Only when 'requested' or 'confirmed'. Requires session_token. Fails if service already assigned or in progress.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for booking tools.

name: fms_estimate_cost
description: Estimates service cost based on service type, land area, and duration. PUBLIC tool. Does NOT create bookings. Estimate is approximate. Fails if service type unsupported or area unrealistic.

name: fms_get_service_details
description: Returns detailed info about a specific service offering. PUBLIC tool. Does NOT check availability. Fails if service_id invalid.

name: fms_raise_grievance
description: Raises FMS grievance. Categories: 'service_not_completed', 'poor_quality_service', 'provider_issue', 'payment_issue', 'scheduling_conflict'. Must check status first. Requires session_token. Fails if category invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for booking tools.

name: fms_track_grievance_status
description: Tracks FMS grievance. Requires session_token. Fails if grievance_id invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for booking tools.
